summary: This PR adds a same-window postMessage bridge so the Account Setup userscript can push a Zoho task's files into the OCR tab and take the Rewaa workbook back, plus a second independent model reading that cross-checks every extracted price before anything is sent. The work is well-built: ADR-0008 documents both decisions with rejected alternatives, `utils/zohoBridge.ts` and `utils/ocrReview.ts` are pure and unit-tested (12 tests pass), five e2e specs cover the auto-start / hold / auto-send paths including the corrupt-payload and partial-cross-check cases, `tsc --noEmit` is clean, every `eslint-disable` carries a reason, and `key={i}` was replaced with a WeakMap row identity. No blocking-handbook violation and nothing high or critical. Two medium items are worth a look: the auto-send gate treats "never cross-checked" as "cross-checked and clean", and the new review panel wraps its interactive list in one aria-live region so keyboard focus is lost on every fix.
